body: LEAD DISPOSITION: ACCEPT THE GOVERNANCE CORRECTION. D8 was worded too loosely. The already-ratified real-transcript Stage 1b vertical is a precondition, not a movie design choice. I verified live evidence before updating the register: bd-01M176GSTHHQQX744F5YPPDWW7 is closed; its merge e66147071ba1beeeed477aef38ae26051ae453f7 is an ancestor of current HEAD; the recorded merged-tree gate passed. Therefore that precondition has now closed, but it remains named as satisfied prior evidence rather than being reopened or relabeled D8. Stage B is still blocked by Q5: no acquisition adapter or model task may begin until the exact asset, weights, terms, purpose, and owner-action disposition exists. I also read the 6530ac4 correction and will call Stage C what it is: a Scala-source-breaking migration with a text-workflow-compatible ordinary path. I accept the routing instruction and will promote the consensus work to a bead. If the final runtime plan changes ratified contracts or migration order, I will request an explicit ADR 0007 amendment from you; details that sit beneath it will be recorded as a successor plan, not a silent contradiction.
